title: TemperatureProfile
description: Specification of temperature conditions throughout the biocatalytic reaction, which can follow various patterns depending on the reaction requirements.

constant_temperature.title: constant_temperature
constant_temperature.description: Temperature value for constant temperature profiles.

gradient.title: gradient
gradient.description: Gradient specifications for temperature ramp profiles.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes about the temperature profile.

profile_points.title: profile_points
profile_points.description: Series of temperature points for event-based or multipoint profiles.

profile_type.title: profile_type
profile_type.description: Type of temperature profile used (constant, event-based, multipoint, or gradient).

temperature_unit.title: temperature_unit
temperature_unit.description: Unit of measurement for temperature values.

Gradient.title: Gradient
Gradient.description: Specification for temperature gradient profiles where temperature changes linearly over time or distance.

end_value.title: end_value
end_value.description: Final temperature value at the end of the gradient.

length.title: length
length.description: Duration or distance over which the gradient is applied.

length_unit.title: length_unit
length_unit.description: Unit of measurement for the gradient length (time or distance).

measurement_points.title: measurement_points
measurement_points.description: Description of how temperature is measured along the gradient.

start_value.title: start_value
start_value.description: Initial temperature value at the beginning of the gradient.

ProfilePoint.title: ProfilePoint
ProfilePoint.description: Individual temperature measurement point in time-based temperature profiles.

event_description.title: event_description
event_description.description: Description of any specific event associated with this temperature point.

time.title: time
time.description: Time at which this temperature is measured or set.

time_unit.title: time_unit
time_unit.description: Unit of measurement for the time value.
